generated_rule: Status is fail-closed. PASS may only be written by a workflow using legally reusable data, the production-equivalent formula and chronological out-of-sample validation. Missing factors or market contexts may not be imputed. Any public confidence index additionally requires untouched out-of-sample calibration; a heuristic score may never be relabelled as confidence.

entry_decision_9plus3.reason: The production entry contract requires nine verified entry factors plus verified US-market, TAIFEX TX and international-event contexts. Legal historical OHLC, TWSE institutional input, international-event feed, production-equivalent OOS validation and confidence calibration are not all complete.

entry_scanner_9plus3.reason: TOP10 must use exactly the same 9+3 contract as single-stock entry analysis across a survivorship-safe TWSE+TPEx universe. No former horizon or objective ranking may substitute, and ranking confidence may not be fabricated from raw factor counts.
required_before_pass: all nine entry factors for every candidate

holding_exit.position_input_contract: Current broker average cost + current shares + first buy date, or user-entered remaining lots (buy date + buy price + currently held shares) with weighted average derived from those user inputs. No inferred position fields.
holding_exit.time_structure_contract: No short/mid/long selector. Actual holding age is the exact count of verified trading-session bars from the user buy date through the latest completed session. Calendar-day approximations are forbidden. Structural lookback may be bounded separately for model stability but must never be labelled as actual holding age.
holding_exit.position_size_rule: Share count may calculate market value and monetary P/L only. Without total portfolio assets and risk budget it must not change the exit signal or claim that the position is too large/small.
holding_exit.reason: The actual-position holding-exit model is separate from entry analysis. The v4 protocol is frozen before OOS. It requires the exact buy trading session to exist in legally reusable history, verified market/risk/corporate-action context, independent production-equivalent OOS validation and separate confidence calibration before any executable exit recommendation may be shown.
required_before_pass: licensed historical OHLC covering the exact buy session
frozen holding-exit-validation-protocol.json satisfied without post-OOS retuning
historical position episodes covering different entry dates and cost bases
chronological OOS and walk-forward when sufficient history exists
minimum 300 OOS episodes and 80 OOS securities
transaction cost/slippage assumptions for exit evaluation
